♈ Aries

🔥 Energy: Today the Moon travels through late Leo and early Virgo, shifting from Uttara Phalguni into your 6th house of work, health and daily discipline by mid-morning. Jupiter freshly in Leo with Ketu nearby continues to stir big questions about how you use your energy. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 7th house of partners and agreements, while Mars, your ruler, presses from Cancer in your 4th. This is a day of rebalancing: how you serve others, how you care for home, and how you honor your own limits.

💼 Career: As the Moon moves into your 6th house, tasks and deadlines demand focus. You may notice systems that used to “kind of work” now show their cracks. Retrograde Mercury and Venus in Libra highlight the need to rework agreements with colleagues, clients or collaborators—especially around who does what and by when. It’s an excellent day for quietly fixing inefficiencies, renegotiating unrealistic expectations, and revisiting an old workflow that can be updated rather than rebuilt from scratch. Mars in the 4th can make you more reactive if work intrudes on your private space; anchor yourself with clear start–stop times so you don’t carry professional frustration through the front door.

❤️ Love: The Libra cluster in your 7th brings relationships to the foreground, but in a reflective way rather than a dramatic one. Old patterns of compromise or conflict may feel more visible. You might realize you’ve been overextending yourself in daily support while skipping your own needs. The Moon’s move into Virgo supports practical, solution-focused conversations with a partner: routines, division of labor, and emotional check-ins that are concrete rather than abstract. If single, you may feel drawn to people who show reliability in small ways—remembering details, keeping their word—rather than just bold chemistry.

💰 Money: Jupiter with Ketu in your 5th/6th axis suggests reviewing how much you spend on “motivation” and “fixing yourself”: subscriptions, courses, productivity tools. Some are useful; others dilute your focus. The Libra emphasis in your 7th also draws attention to shared expenses, retainers or contracts. Retrograde Venus supports revisiting fee structures with clients, amending joint financial agreements, or gently questioning arrangements where you shoulder more than your share. Today favors tightening slow leaks rather than chasing big scores.

🧘 Advice: Let small, well-chosen adjustments do the heavy lifting—one clear boundary at home, one clarified agreement at work, one supportive habit for your body.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The balance you want today starts the moment you stop doing other people’s work in silence.
taurus:
♉ Taurus

🔥 Energy: The Moon begins the day at the end of Leo in Uttara Phalguni and moves into Virgo, activating your 5th house of creativity, joy and children. Jupiter newly in Leo with Ketu near your 4th brings a slow reorganization of home and emotional roots. Meanwhile, the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus (your ruler) in Libra charge your 6th house of routines and service, and Mars in Cancer energizes your 3rd house of communication. The sky nudges you to weave more genuine enjoyment into a life that has recently felt overly practical.

💼 Career: With so much energy in your 6th house, you’re in a powerful period for redesigning how you work—not just what you do. Retrograde Venus and Mercury favor reviewing your schedule, renegotiating expectations, and simplifying overcomplicated processes. As the Moon moves into your 5th, creative solutions appear more easily: new ways to package your services, a more engaging format for meetings, or a more human tone in your emails and proposals. Mars in your 3rd gives you courage to speak up if something is inefficient, but check your delivery; direct doesn’t have to mean sharp.

❤️ Love: The Virgo Moon in your 5th emphasizes thoughtful affection rather than sweeping gestures. You may find pleasure in quietly planning something considerate for your partner or loved ones—a meal, a shared errand turned into a micro-adventure, help with a task that’s been weighing on them. If partnered, talking about what actually feels fun and restorative for both of you will matter more than following old “date night” scripts. If single, attraction may grow toward someone you see regularly in everyday spaces—neighbors, colleagues, classmates—where their consistency and kindness show over time.

💰 Money: The Libra stellium in your 6th asks you to examine the exchange between effort and income. Are you undercharging for meticulous work? Taking on “small favors” that eat paid hours? Retrograde Venus supports recalibrating prices, editing retainers, or phasing out tasks that exhaust you for little return. At the same time, the 5th-house Moon may tempt you to spend on hobbies, children or treats. Choose the few pleasures that genuinely nourish your heart instead of scattering money across many small distractions.

🧘 Advice: Let your sense of quality guide you—one well-crafted routine, one meaningful connection, one purchase that truly supports the life you’re building.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your peace today grows each time you choose genuine enjoyment over mere obligation or habit.
gemini:
♊ Gemini

🔥 Energy: The Moon transitions from late Leo to Virgo, moving from your busy 3rd house into your 4th house of home, inner security and emotional grounding later in the day. Jupiter at the very start of Leo with Ketu nearby keeps your mind ranging far and wide, but the Virgo Moon invites you inward. Your ruler Mercury is retrograde in Libra alongside the Sun and Venus, lighting up your 5th house of self-expression and romance. Mars in Cancer travels through your 2nd house of money and speech. You’re revisiting what feels like “home” while reworking how you express your talents.

💼 Career: With Mercury retrograde in your creative 5th, today favors refining and reimagining rather than launching. Old concepts, drafts or pitches could be polished into something sharper. The Moon’s move into your 4th suggests working from a space that feels settled will dramatically improve your focus—clearing a desk, rearranging a corner, or setting a more peaceful background for calls. Mars in your 2nd sharpens your negotiating instincts; you may feel an urge to correct underpricing or to speak more frankly about the value you bring. Keep your tone grounded and specific so it lands as confidence, not agitation.

❤️ Love: The Libra stellium in your 5th house keeps your heart busy—remembering past loves, re-evaluating what kind of relationship actually lets you shine, reconsidering what “fun” means now. If partnered, this is a good day to revive a shared interest you’ve let slide: a show, a creative project, a hobby that helps you laugh together again. As the Moon enters your 4th, private moments matter more than public displays. If single, you may feel a pull toward someone who feels emotionally familiar, perhaps linked to your neighborhood, family connections, or a place you retreat to regularly.

💰 Money: Mars in your 2nd can bring urgency around finances—wanting to accelerate earnings, pay off something faster, or cut off a draining expense. Combined with retrograde Venus in your 5th, it’s a strong day to review spending on entertainment, subscriptions, and creative pursuits. Some investments in your skills or joy are worth keeping; others sap resources without feeding you. Aim for clear, practical steps rather than impulsive financial moves.

🧘 Advice: Give equal weight to the story in your head and the feeling in your body—your best decisions today will satisfy both.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real security now comes from expressing who you are honestly, not from performing who you think others expect.
cancer:
♋ Cancer

🔥 Energy: The Moon, your ruler, shifts from late Leo into Virgo, moving from your 2nd house of resources into your 3rd house of communication and local environment. Jupiter at the start of Leo with Ketu close by continues to stretch your sense of what you can do with your skills and earnings, but the Virgo Moon brings attention to details—calls, messages, and short-term plans. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra highlight your 4th house of home and family, while Mars in your sign stirs personal drive and sensitivity. Home, words and movement all intertwine today.

💼 Career: This is a strong day for clear, careful communication. The Virgo Moon in your 3rd supports editing, documenting, planning and following up. You may feel an urge to finally answer lingering emails, clarify instructions, or smooth out a process that regularly causes confusion. The Libra stellium in your 4th hints that career decisions are entangled with domestic ones: workspace boundaries, relocation ideas, or how your role impacts family dynamics. Under the retrogrades, revisiting past discussions with family about your working hours or setup could lead to more sustainable arrangements.

❤️ Love: With Mars in your 1st, your emotions show more readily on your face and in your tone. The Libra emphasis in your 4th house brings relationship focus to the deepest layers: how safe you feel together at home, how conflict is handled, and how each person’s background shapes their needs. If partnered, gentle conversations about household rhythms, privacy, and emotional support can bring surprising relief, especially if you’ve been silently adjusting around others. If single, you may feel more aware of what kind of “home atmosphere” you want to build with someone, making it easier to discern who is—and isn’t—a fit.

💰 Money: The shift of the Moon through your 2nd and into your 3rd draws attention first to spending, then to the conversations around it. You may start the day aware of recent outlays on home or family, then feel the need to talk through budgets, bills or shared expenses. Jupiter in your 2nd over the longer term can increase both earning potential and generosity; today is a good moment to look honestly at where giving has turned into quiet resentment. Aim for clearer agreements rather than emotional bookkeeping.

🧘 Advice: Let yourself be both soft and specific—your feelings are valid, and they deserve words that actually match them.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Every honest conversation you start today is a brick in the kind of home life you truly want.
leo:
♌ Leo

🔥 Energy: The Moon leaves your sign and enters Virgo, moving from your 1st into your 2nd house of values and income, while Jupiter at the first degree of Leo travels close to Ketu. You’re standing in a threshold season: old versions of yourself are quietly loosening their grip as new possibilities appear. The Sun—your ruler—sits in Libra with retrograde Mercury and Venus in your 3rd house of mind and communication, and Mars pushes from Cancer through your 12th house of the subconscious. The mood shifts from self-display to subtle realignment of priorities.

💼 Career: With the Moon stepping into your 2nd, attention turns to what your time and talents are actually worth. You may feel motivated to get practical about rates, salary, or the kinds of projects you accept. The Libra stellium in your 3rd supports thoughtful rephrasing: refining your bio, revising proposals, or reworking presentations so they convey more accuracy and less performance. Because Mercury and Venus are retrograde, returning to an earlier idea, contact or format can be more fruitful than inventing something brand new. Mars in your 12th suggests there may be hidden frustrations around recognition; instead of letting them leak out sideways, channel that energy into quiet, strategic planning.

❤️ Love: The 3rd-house Libra focus makes conversations, messages and small gestures the heart of relationship today. If partnered, you might revisit topics you skimmed over—how you speak to each other under stress, how often you truly listen, or how you share news about your days. The Virgo Moon in your 2nd values consistency over flash; you’ll likely feel loved through reliability and practical support. If single, you may find sparks in thoughtful exchanges—someone whose words feel precise, kind and a little surprising. Choose the person who makes your nervous system feel calmer, not just the one who flatters your ego.

💰 Money: As the Moon lights your 2nd, it’s a good day for small but meaningful financial housekeeping: adjusting budgets, reviewing auto-payments, or following up on money owed. Jupiter’s long transit beginning in your sign can gradually open doors, but Ketu nearby asks you to release outdated status markers. Money decisions that align with authentic priorities, rather than image maintenance, will feel most satisfying. Beware of late-night or secret spending under Mars in the 12th; bring those impulses into the light and ask what you’re really trying to soothe.

🧘 Advice: Let humility and precision walk beside your natural charisma; when your inner and outer values match, your influence deepens.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The shine that lasts is the one built on choices that truly reflect what matters to you now, not who you used to be.
virgo:
♍ Virgo

🔥 Energy: The Moon crosses into your sign today, entering Virgo and your 1st house, while Jupiter has just stepped into Leo with Ketu close by in your 12th. You’re extra sensitive to undercurrents, both within and around you. Your ruler Mercury is retrograde in Libra with the Sun and Venus in your 2nd house of money and self-worth. Mars in Cancer energizes your 11th house of friends and long-term goals. The day carries a quiet but strong invitation to recalibrate how you show up, what you accept, and which circles you invest in.

💼 Career: With the Moon in your 1st, your attention to detail—and your tendency to notice what’s off—are heightened. Use that gift constructively: improve a process, refine a document, or correct an oversight that matters. The Libra stellium in your 2nd emphasizes the link between your contributions and how you’re valued. This is a powerful time to reconsider pricing, compensation, and the mix of tasks you do. Retrograde Mercury supports reviewing past performance reviews, old offers, or previous income streams you might revive in a more balanced form. Mars in your 11th may stir both inspiration and irritation around teams or online communities; put energy into alliances that respect your boundaries rather than trying to “fix” every group.

❤️ Love: With your 1st house lit, your own needs, rhythms and preferences move closer to the surface. You may realize where you’ve been subtly adjusting too much, or where you’ve downplayed your standards to keep the peace. The 2nd-house Libra activation asks: Do your relationships leave you feeling appreciated in tangible ways—time, effort, responsiveness—or mostly in theory? If partnered, gentle but specific requests (“Can we plan one uninterrupted hour together this week?”) are more effective than general complaints. If single, you may feel drawn to people who are grounded and fair with themselves, not just charming with others.

💰 Money: With three planets in your 2nd, including retrograde Venus, finances are under review. Today is constructive for going through statements, closing out old obligations, and renegotiating terms that no longer fit. Focus especially on subtle drains: shared expenses that default to you, services you rarely use, or roles where you give much more support than you’re formally rewarded for. Jupiter and Ketu in your 12th suggest that releasing certain financial burdens or expectations will enhance both peace and future opportunity.

🧘 Advice: Treat your sensitivity as data, not as a flaw—what feels “too much” or “not enough” is pointing directly at the adjustments you’re ready to make.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The standard you quietly hold for others today is the one you’re finally meant to apply to your own life too.
libra:
♎ Libra

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves from late Leo into Virgo, shifting focus from your 11th house of community into your 12th house of retreat and inner processing. Meanwhile, the Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus all travel through your sign, intensely spotlighting identity, body and personal direction. Jupiter just into Leo with Ketu nearby occupies your 11th, and Mars in Cancer activates your 10th house of career. You’re visible and in demand, yet part of you longs for quiet space to feel into who you’re becoming.

💼 Career: Mars high in your chart keeps ambitions stirred; you may be juggling responsibilities, expectations from superiors, and your own evolving goals. The Leo-to-Virgo Moon shift asks you to move from outward engagement to inner sorting: which professional roles actually fit the version of yourself emerging now? With the stellium in your 1st, this is less about what looks impressive and more about what feels congruent. Retrograde Mercury and Venus favor updating how you present yourself—portfolios, photos, titles—but also revisiting old paths or contacts with fresh eyes. Today, give yourself at least a little time offstage to reflect before accepting additional commitments.

❤️ Love: With so much energy in your own sign, your needs in relationship are louder, even if you’re accustomed to prioritizing others. You may feel less tolerant of vague promises or emotional half-presence. The Moon’s move into your 12th can stir dreams or memories of past connections, as well as a desire for deeper, quieter intimacy. If partnered, sharing what is shifting inside you—even if the words feel imperfect—can create a new layer of honesty. If single, you might feel called to step back from active pursuit and instead tend to your own self-image and healing; doing so can quietly change whom you attract.

💰 Money: Jupiter and Ketu in your 11th highlight income connected to organizations, networks and long-term projects, but also suggest letting go of purely status-based goals. The current transits encourage you to ask: What level of responsibility and visibility truly feels worth the compensation and time? Retrograde Venus in your 1st can bring opportunities to renegotiate terms, especially where your role has grown but recognition hasn’t kept pace. Avoid rushing decisions today; subtle insights about what you genuinely want from your work life are still forming.

🧘 Advice: Make a little room today where no one needs anything from you; the choices that follow will be clearer and kinder to everyone.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your life starts to rebalance the moment you stop treating your own needs as a footnote.
scorpio:
♏ Scorpio

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels from late Leo into Virgo, moving from your 10th house of visibility into your 11th house of networks and aspirations. Jupiter at the start of Leo with Ketu near continues to reshape your sense of vocation over the long term. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra occupy your 12th house of retreat, endings and the subconscious. Mars, your traditional ruler, is in Cancer in your 9th house of belief and exploration. This is a threshold day: part of you is already living in your next chapter while another part is quietly closing doors behind the scenes.

💼 Career: The earlier part of the day may bring attention or responsibilities, but as the Moon enters your 11th, collaboration and planning with others become more prominent. It’s an excellent time to review which groups, platforms or alliances still make sense. The Libra stellium in your 12th shows that much of your professional transformation is happening offstage: reconsidering an old dream, feeling done with a role you haven’t outwardly left yet, or preparing to let go of obligations that no longer align. Retrograde Mercury and Venus support confidential conversations, edits to plans, and gradual transitions rather than abrupt departures. Mars in your 9th wants your work to reflect your real beliefs; you may feel a rising intolerance for paths that contradict your ethics.

❤️ Love: The 12th-house Libra focus turns your attention to the hidden layers of relationship—what goes unspoken, the way you forgive, where you keep emotional distance. If partnered, this can be a day of quiet but meaningful connection: honest sharing after a long day, or simply resting side by side without performance. Old relational stories may arise, asking to be understood differently. If single, you may feel drawn to people with a sense of depth or spiritual resonance, perhaps met through learning or long-distance connections (Mars in the 9th). Go slowly; give yourself time to sense whether emotional availability matches the intensity of the bond.

💰 Money: Jupiter in your 10th can gradually expand career-related earnings, but with Ketu close, you’re encouraged to detach from chasing status at any cost. Financially, today is better for background work—reviewing subscriptions, consolidating debts, or privately planning shifts in how you earn—than for major public moves. Libra in your 12th may highlight hidden expenses or quiet generosity; look gently at where your desire to help has slid into unsustainable sacrifice.

🧘 Advice: Trust the slow, subtle signals that something is complete; you don’t have to force endings, but you also don’t have to pretend you’re still fully in.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The power you’re reclaiming now comes from aligning your outer path with truths you’ve already admitted to yourself in private.
sagittarius:
♐ Sagittarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon shifts from Leo to Virgo, moving from your 9th house of vision into your 10th house of career and public role later in the day. Your ruler Jupiter has just entered Leo, still close to Ketu, opening a longer phase of expanding your horizons while releasing old dogmas. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra energize your 11th house of communities and long-term aims. Mars in Cancer continues through your 8th house of shared resources and emotional intensity. Today blends big-picture thinking with concrete responsibility.

💼 Career: As the Moon climbs into your 10th house, visibility and accountability increase. You may be asked to clarify a plan, take the lead on a project, or deliver something that represents your team. The Libra cluster in your 11th encourages you to look carefully at the people and structures surrounding your work: which networks genuinely support your direction, and which mainly consume your energy? Retrograde Mercury and Venus make this a good day to reconnect with former mentors or allies, review long-range goals, and adjust your role in groups. Mars in your 8th suggests that financial or power dynamics in collaborations are active; aim for transparent, fact-based discussions instead of silent resentment.

❤️ Love: The 11th-house activation blurs lines between friendship and romance. You might feel drawn to someone in your wider circle or find that your existing relationship needs more shared social life and common ideals. If partnered, conversations about future dreams—where you might live, what kind of community you want, how you share resources with others—can bring you closer. The Virgo Moon in your 10th reminds you that how a relationship functions under pressure or in public settings is as important as how it feels in private.

💰 Money: Mars in your 8th continues to stir matters of shared finances—debts, taxes, inheritances, joint accounts or business partnerships. Today’s transits are suitable for clarifying numbers, updating agreements, and setting clearer boundaries about who is responsible for what. The Libra planets in your 11th may also highlight finances tied to organizations, memberships or causes; you might choose to redirect support or tighten contributions so they match your real capacity.

🧘 Advice: Let today’s responsibilities be shaped by the future you actually want, not just by the roles you’ve drifted into.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The opportunities that matter most now are the ones that move both your life and your ideals in the same direction.
capricorn:
♑ Capricorn

🔥 Energy: The Moon travels from late Leo into Virgo, shifting its light from your 8th house of depth and shared resources into your 9th house of learning and perspective. Jupiter at the start of Leo with Ketu nearby continues to quietly rework your approach to intimacy, power and long-term investments. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra sit high in your chart in the 10th house, and your ruler Saturn is retrograde in Pisces in your 3rd. Mars in Cancer energizes your 7th house of partnerships. Serious, relationship-linked questions about your path are in the air.

💼 Career: With a Libra stellium in your 10th, the spotlight is on your public role and the balance within it. Retrograde Mercury and Venus make today useful for reassessing titles, expectations and how you’re perceived. You might revise a professional profile, reconsider a leadership position, or reopen discussions about how success is measured. The Moon’s shift into your 9th brings a desire to step back and see the broader pattern—through research, consultation with a mentor, or simply a walk that lets insights land. Saturn in your 3rd encourages sober, precise communication; even difficult conversations can go well if you ground them in facts and long-term benefit.

❤️ Love: Mars in your 7th house intensifies one-to-one interactions. That can look like productive teamwork, lively debate, or, if tension is already present, sharper exchanges. Combined with the 8th/9th Moon movement, you may feel ready to talk honestly about deeper topics: trust, future plans, shared responsibilities. If partnered, choose one significant subject rather than trying to solve everything at once; give it your full, calm attention. If single, you may be drawn to people who challenge your thinking or come from different backgrounds, but who show emotional steadiness over time.

💰 Money: The Leo–Ketu emphasis in your 8th highlights long-term and intertwined finances—loans, investments, inheritances, or joint business assets. Today favors reviewing these patiently: understanding terms, checking timelines, and evaluating whether certain commitments still serve your goals. The Libra 10th-house cluster suggests that financial shifts may be linked to career changes or redefined roles. Avoid hasty moves; aim for gradual realignment anchored in clear information.

🧘 Advice: Give yourself permission to think in years, not just weeks; decisions made from that altitude will feel far less pressured.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: Your real authority today comes from pairing long-range vision with honest conversations—especially with the people who stand beside you.
aquarius:
♒ Aquarius

🔥 Energy: The Moon moves from late Leo into Virgo, traveling from your 7th house of partnership into your 8th house of intimacy, shared resources and psychological depth. Jupiter at the start of Leo with Ketu nearby continues to reshape how you relate to key others. The Sun, retrograde Mercury and retrograde Venus in Libra activate your 9th house of beliefs and expansion, while Saturn, your traditional ruler, retrograde in Pisces works through your 2nd house of income and values. Mars in Cancer occupies your 6th house of work and health. Surface agreements give way to deeper truths today.

💼 Career: With Mars in your 6th, you have energy to tackle tasks, but also a lower tolerance for disorganization. Channel this into improving systems rather than fixating on coworkers’ flaws. The Libra stellium in your 9th encourages you to re-examine the principles behind your work: ethics, purpose and how much growth or change you actually want. Retrograde Mercury and Venus support revisiting old plans for study, certification or a shift in niche. As the Moon enters your 8th, collaborative projects that involve shared budgets, confidential data or long-term commitments may need attention; read the fine print and ask the questions you’ve been postponing.

❤️ Love: Relationship energy deepens today. The Moon’s move from your 7th to your 8th moves focus from “how we appear together” to “how we truly share.” Topics like trust, vulnerability, and how you handle fear or jealousy may surface. The Libra 9th influence asks whether your relationships support your growth and worldview: do you feel freer and more honest with this person over time? If partnered, this is a good day for a calm, non-rushed conversation about future direction or a sensitive emotional topic. If single, you may feel attracted to someone who expands your perspective, perhaps through cultural, spiritual or educational differences.

💰 Money: Saturn in your 2nd keeps finances under serious review, and the Moon in your 8th brings shared or complex money matters into focus—loans, taxes, partner income, or joint investments. Today is suited to sorting through paperwork, clarifying obligations, and identifying which commitments feel heavy versus supportive. The Libra 9th cluster suggests that some financial decisions may tie into travel, education or legal matters; take your time and, if needed, seek expert input rather than guessing.

🧘 Advice: Stay curious when deeper topics arise—in yourself and with others. Questions asked kindly will move you farther than assumptions made quickly.

⚡ Mauksh Truth: The connections that truly belong in your future are the ones where honesty feels like relief, not risk.
